name: Qwen Image Edit Easy Inpaint LoRA
description: Note: this is for Qwen Image Edit , not Qwen Image. This lora inpaints over completely black areas in an image. Start your prompt with this: Inpaint the black areas. You can add additional instructions after the first sentence to inpaint in specific ways. You can also use this along with regular Qwen Image loras to influence the output. Sample workflow here: https://pastebin.com/scfjfX9v Workflow uses a node from Unusual-Tools: https://github.com/Diohim/ComfyUI-Unusual-Tools You can do without this node if you want to just black out areas in your favorite paint program. I didn't test this on soft edges, so YMMV if you don't use a hard brush.
